subdivision_of_building: This application does not affect the existing building
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - Time limit

The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period, being the period of three years from the date of this decision. The two single storey temporary cabins hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before 10th April 2029 in accordance with a scheme of work that shall first have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The site shall be made good no later than one month after the removal of the buildings.#

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 3 - In accordance with approved plans and documents

The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2798-17-P2, Reasonable Exemption Statement and Flood Map for Planning. Received 18/12/2025; 2798-00-P3, 2798-01-P3, 2798-11-P3, 2798-15-P3, 2798-17-P3, 14 Rev P3, 19 Rev P3 and Planning, Design and Access Statement. Received 25/02/2026; 3370-ENG-ZZ-00-DGA-ME-0001 and 20 Rev P3. Received 19/03/2026) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are used.

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 4 - Drainage design 

Prior to commencement of groundworks involving the installation of the two single storey temporary cabins hereby permitted along the north boundary of the site (excluding site investigations, site clearance, demolition and the installation of one non-turf cricket pitch and works to erect ball stop netting), the applicant must submit a final detailed drainage design including drawings and supporting calculations including suitable infiltration rates to be evidenced [and updated Drainage Assessment Form] to the Lead Local Flood Authority for review and approval, aligned with the Surface Drainage Plan (19/03/2026) and associated drawings. The drainage hierarchy shall make use of green infrastructure technology where possible to comply with the hierarchy set out in London Plan Policy SI 13. A detailed management plan confirming routine maintenance tasks for all drainage components must also be submitted to demonstrate how the drainage system is to be maintained for the lifetime of the development (two single storey temporary cabins). A maintenance owner should be provided.

Reason: In order to prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site.
Condition : 5 - Built in accordance with drainage details 

The two single storey temporary cabins hereby permitted shall not be occupied until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) is submitted to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme for the site has been completed in accordance with the submitted details. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Reason: In order to ensure that the methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been implemented as agreed and that the drainage system is suitably managed.
description: Repair and enhancement of the existing ball-stop netting and new ball stop netting and poles along the west boundary adjacent to Boston Manor Road, installation of one non-turf cricket pitch and installation of a small temporary accommodation cabin
